plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) parse annotations.json — count annotations, categories, annotations per image distribution, (3) image dimensions, (4) category frequency distribution (how many categories have <5 annotations), (5) examine metadata.json structure, (6) check data/products/ directory structure and count reference images per product.
plan.success_criteria: Clear log of dataset statistics: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, category distribution, reference image counts

plan.title: Explore dataset and environment without numpy
plan.hypothesis: We can understand the dataset structure using only stdlib (json, pathlib, statistics) and check what packages are available
plan.description: Rewrite scratch.py to use only Python stdlib (no numpy, no PIL). Use json to parse annotations.json and metadata.json. Use pathlib to count images and product directories. Use statistics module for mean/median. Also run 'pip list' via subprocess to see installed packages, check torch availability, check if ultralytics is installed. Print all findings.
plan.success_criteria: Successfully prints dataset statistics (image count, annotation count, category count, annotations per image distribution, category frequency distribution) and environment info (installed packages, CUDA availability)

plan.title: Install dependencies and create train/val split + YOLO format conversion
plan.hypothesis: Installing ultralytics and creating proper data splits enables training
plan.description: In main.py: (1) pip install ultralytics pycocotools ensemble-boxes if not present, (2) parse annotations.json, (3) create 90/10 stratified train/val split (seed=42), (4) convert to YOLO format directory structure (images/train, images/val, labels/train, labels/val), (5) create dataset.yaml, (6) write evaluation function that computes val_score = 0.7*det_mAP@0.5 + 0.3*cls_mAP@0.5
plan.success_criteria: Train/val split created with ~223/25 images, YOLO format labels generated, dataset.yaml created, evaluation function tested

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with 357 classes at 640px establishes a reasonable baseline val_score > 0.10
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m on train split with nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Run inference on val split, evaluate with val_score function. Skip nano/small to save time - medium is a good starting point.
plan.success_criteria: Model trains successfully and produces a measurable val_score

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Larger model + higher resolution significantly improves val_score on dense shelf images with small products
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=150, batch=4. Evaluate val_score. This tests the upper end of single-stage YOLO performance.

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 detection-only at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector achieves higher detection_mAP since it doesn't need to distinguish 357 classes
plan.description: Convert all annotations to single class. Train YOLOv8x at 1280px, epochs=150. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5. This will serve as the detection backbone for two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 exceeds that of the nc=357 model

plan.title: Explore reference product images and build DINOv2 embedding gallery
plan.hypothesis: Reference product images + DINOv2 embeddings enable effective kNN classification
plan.description: Examine data/products/ directory coverage. Load DINOv2-base from torch hub. Build gallery from: (a) reference product images, (b) training annotation crops. Test kNN classification on a few val crops. Measure gallery coverage of 357 categories.
plan.success_criteria: Gallery built with embeddings for majority of categories, kNN produces reasonable classifications on sample crops

plan.title: Two-stage: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2-base kNN classification
plan.hypothesis: Two-stage approach achieves higher val_score than single-stage nc=357 YOLO
plan.description: Use nc=1 detector from step 6 for boxes. For each detection, crop from full-res image, extract DINOv2-base embedding, classify via kNN (k=5, cosine similarity) against gallery. Evaluate full val_score. Also sweep k={1,3,5,7} and test cosine vs L2.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best single-stage YOLO result

plan.title: NMS/confidence threshold tuning + TTA
plan.hypothesis: Tuning post-processing parameters and adding TTA improves detection_mAP by 2-5 points
plan.description: On best detector, sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7}, confidence threshold {0.05,0.1,0.15,0.25}, and test TTA (augment=True). Find optimal combination on val split.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves by at least 1 point over default thresholds

plan.title: SAHI tiled inference for small product detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference with overlapping crops significantly improves detection of small products on high-res shelf images
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice each image into overlapping tiles (1280x1280, stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Evaluate detection_mAP improvement.

plan.title: Extended training: YOLOv8x 300 epochs with close_mosaic tuning
plan.hypothesis: Longer training with late mosaic closing improves model quality
plan.description: Retrain best YOLO model with epochs=300, close_mosaic=50. Compare val_score against shorter training.

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces better embeddings for fine-grained product classification
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large, rebuild gallery, run kNN classification on val detections. Compare classification_mAP against DINOv2-base. Check model size for weight budget.

plan.title: Gallery composition and multi-crop DINOv2 inference
plan.hypothesis: Optimal gallery mix and multi-crop averaging improve classification robustness
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (a) reference only, (b) training crops only, (c) both. Also test multi-crop: extract original + center-zoomed + padded crops, average embeddings before kNN. Evaluate classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improves over single-crop baseline gallery

plan.title: Confidence-gated hybrid: YOLO class + DINOv2 fallback
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves overall classification
plan.description: For each detection from nc=357 model, if YOLO class confidence > threshold use YOLO prediction, else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep threshold on val split. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds both pure YOLO and pure DINOv2 approaches

plan.title: RT-DETR-l training and WBF ensemble with YOLO
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO and RT-DETR with WBF improves detection_mAP by 2-4 points
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=1 at 1280px. Run both YOLO and RT-DETR on val split. Merge with WBF, sweep IoU threshold and weights. Evaluate detection_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble detection_mAP exceeds best single model by at least 1 point

plan.title: Final hyperparameter sweep on best pipeline
plan.hypothesis: Fine-tuning remaining hyperparameters squeezes out final val_score gains
plan.description: On best pipeline, sweep: NMS threshold, confidence threshold, kNN k, gallery weights, WBF parameters, crop padding. Grid search on val split.

plan.title: Build and validate final run.py submission
plan.description: Write run.py that: (1) loads best detector, (2) loads DINOv2 + gallery, (3) implements best inference pipeline (tiling if beneficial), (4) outputs predictions.json. Verify: correct format, inference time < 300s extrapolated, total weights < 420 MB. Run on val split to confirm val_score matches.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct predictions.json, val_score matches best experiment, weights < 420 MB
